entities.name: 551-aa query protein
observations: Sequence-derived length is 551 aa; estimated molecular mass 58.38 kDa and theoretical pI 5.39.

Swiss-Prot hits to bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme Nnr have 30.5–32.6% identity over about 97% query coverage (E-values 5.11e-59 to 1.4e-56); function assignment is limited homology support.
Sequence Pfam matches YjeF_N (PF03853; residues 39–210) and Carb_kinase (PF01256; residues 292–528).
Likely function by homology: NAD(P)HX epimerization plus ADP-dependent dehydration of (6S)-NAD(P)HX; potassium binding is annotated in the reference homologs, not directly verified for this query.
Reference homolog annotations associate the function with NAD(P)H-hydrate repair (EC 5.1.99.6 and 4.2.1.136); exact activity and substrate specificity remain unverified for this query.

entities.name: NAD(P)HX repair Nnr
observations: Reviewed Swiss-Prot homolog records describe Nnr as an enzyme that epimerizes R/S NAD(P)HX and dehydrates S-NAD(P)HX with ADP converted to AMP; annotations include potassium binding.
Reported catalytic annotations include NAD(P)HX epimerase (EC 5.1.99.6) and ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase (EC 4.2.1.136).
